risk.detail: Shared generated projections can make otherwise isolated Work Item branches conflict or misrepresent integration truth.

observedIssues.detail: #659 discovered merge-unsafe branch-integrated generated lifecycle projections.

The first quality attempt used system python3 with Ruff 0.15.21 and failed the repository's locked Ruff 0.16.0 version gate; rerun uses the existing repository-root locked virtual environment without changing dependency files.

Unconditional lease acquisition incorrectly rejected installer and isolated legacy fixtures on main. The lease now activates only for an explicit concurrencyBoundary; explicit parallel Work Items retain the dedicated-branch and fresh-base requirement.

Unconditional closure release could collide with another active Work Item lease. Closure now reads the archived Contract and releases only for an explicit concurrencyBoundary; exact-owner mismatch remains fail-closed.
